# lib/db_driver/ntlm_auth.rb
require 'socket'
require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'logger'

module DbDriver
  module Auth
    class NTLMSession
      NEGOTIATE_FLAGS = 0x00088207
      CHALLENGE_FLAGS = 0x00028233
      
      attr_reader :state, :server_challenge, :session_key
      
      def initialize(config)
        @config = config
        @state = :initial
        @audit_log = AuditLogger.new(config[:log_path] || '/var/log/db_driver/auth.log')
        @channel_binding = config.fetch(:channel_binding, true)
        @require_signing = config.fetch(:require_signing, true)
        @require_seal = config.fetch(:require_seal, true)
      end

      def authenticate(connection)
        @connection = connection
        negotiate_msg = build_negotiate_message
        @audit_log.log_event(:negotiate, remote: connection.peer_address)
        
        connection.send_auth_packet(negotiate_msg)
        @state = :negotiate_sent
        
        challenge_response = connection.recv_auth_packet
        unless valid_challenge?(challenge_response)
          @audit_log.log_event(:invalid_challenge, remote: connection.peer_address)
          raise AuthError, "Invalid NTLM challenge received"
        end
        
        @server_challenge = extract_challenge(challenge_response)
        @state = :challenge_received
        
        auth_msg = build_authenticate_message(challenge_response)
        connection.send_auth_packet(auth_msg)
        @state = :auth_sent
        
        result = connection.recv_auth_result
        if result[:success]
          @state = :authenticated
          @session_key = derive_session_key(result)
          setup_message_integrity(connection)
          @audit_log.log_event(:auth_success, remote: connection.peer_address, user: @config[:username])
        else
          @state = :failed
          @audit_log.log_event(:auth_failed, remote: connection.peer_address, user: @config[:username])
          raise AuthError, "Authentication failed: #{result[:reason]}"
        end
        
        @state == :authenticated
      end

      private

      def build_negotiate_message
        flags = NEGOTIATE_FLAGS
        flags |= 0x00000010 if @require_signing  # NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_SIGN
        flags |= 0x00000020 if @require_seal     # NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_SEAL
        
        msg = "NTLMSSP\x00"
        msg << [1].pack('V')           # Type 1
        msg << [flags].pack('V')       # Flags
        msg << domain_fields
        msg << workstation_fields
        msg
      end

      def valid_challenge?(data)
        return false if data.nil? || data.length < 32
        return false unless data[0..7] == "NTLMSSP\x00"
        return false unless data[8..11].unpack1('V') == 2
        true
      end

      def extract_challenge(data)
        data[24..31]
      end

      def build_authenticate_message(challenge_data)
        server_flags = challenge_data[20..23].unpack1('V')
        
        # Validate server supports required security features
        validate_server_flags!(server_flags)
        
        target_info = extract_target_info(challenge_data)
        timestamp = generate_timestamp
        client_challenge = SecureRandom.random_bytes(8)
        
        nt_response = compute_nt_response(
          @config[:password],
          @config[:username],
          @config[:domain],
          @server_challenge,
          client_challenge,
          timestamp,
          target_info
        )
        
        lm_response = compute_lm_response(client_challenge)
        
        msg = "NTLMSSP\x00"
        msg << [3].pack('V')  # Type 3
        msg << build_auth_fields(lm_response, nt_response)
        msg
      end

      def validate_server_flags!(server_flags)
        if @require_signing && (server_flags & 0x00000010) == 0
          raise AuthError, "Server does not support message signing"
        end
        if @require_seal && (server_flags & 0x00000020) == 0
          raise AuthError, "Server does not support message sealing"
        end
      end

      def verify_channel_binding(connection)
        return true unless @channel_binding
        
        tls_cert = connection.peer_cert
        return true if tls_cert.nil?  # No TLS, skip binding
        
        cert_hash = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.digest(tls_cert.to_der)
        expected_binding = "tls-server-end-point:" + cert_hash
        
        @channel_binding_token = expected_binding
        true
      end

      def setup_message_integrity(connection)
        if @require_signing
          connection.enable_signing(@session_key)
        end
        if @require_seal
          connection.enable_sealing(@session_key)
        end
      end

      def extract_target_info(challenge_data)
        info_len = challenge_data[40..41].unpack1('v')
        info_offset = challenge_data[44..47].unpack1('V')
        challenge_data[info_offset, info_len]
      end

      def compute_nt_response(password, username, domain, server_challenge, client_challenge, timestamp, target_info)
        nt_hash = OpenSSL::Digest::MD4.digest(password.encode('UTF-16LE'))
        ntlm_v2_hash = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('MD5', nt_hash, (username.upcase + domain).encode('UTF-16LE'))
        
        # Build NTLMv2 client blob
        blob = "\x01\x01"           # Blob signature
        blob << "\x00" * 6          # Reserved
        blob << [timestamp].pack('Q<')
        blob << client_challenge
        blob << "\x00" * 4          # Reserved
        blob << target_info
        blob << "\x00" * 4          # End of target info
        
        # Channel binding - append MsvAvFlags if enabled
        if @channel_binding && @channel_binding_token
          blob << build_channel_binding_av_pair
        end
        
        proof = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('MD5', ntlm_v2_hash, server_challenge + blob)
        proof + blob
      end

      def compute_lm_response(client_challenge)
        "\x00" * 24  # NTLMv2: LM response is zeroed
      end

      def build_channel_binding_av_pair
        # MsvAvChannelBindings (0x000A)
        av_id = [0x000A].pack('v')
        binding_hash = OpenSSL::Digest::MD5.digest(@channel_binding_token)
        av_len = [binding_hash.length].pack('v')
        av_id + av_len + binding_hash
      end

      def domain_fields
        domain = (@config[:domain] || '').encode('UTF-16LE')
        [domain.length, domain.length, 40].pack('vvV')
      end

      def workstation_fields
        ws = (Socket.gethostname || '').encode('UTF-16LE')
        [ws.length, ws.length, 40 + (@config[:domain] || '').encode('UTF-16LE').length].pack('vvV')
      end

      def generate_timestamp
        # Windows FILETIME: 100-nanosecond intervals since 1601-01-01
        epoch_diff = 116444736000000000
        (Time.now.to_f * 10000000).to_i + epoch_diff
      end

      def derive_session_key(result)
        result[:session_key] || SecureRandom.random_bytes(16)
      end

      def build_auth_fields(lm_response, nt_response)
        offset = 88  # Fixed header size for Type 3
        fields = ''
        
        # LM Response
        fields << [lm_response.length, lm_response.length, offset].pack('vvV')
        offset += lm_response.length
        
        # NT Response  
        fields << [nt_response.length, nt_response.length, offset].pack('vvV')
        offset += nt_response.length
        
        # Domain, User, Workstation fields
        domain_bytes = (@config[:domain] || '').encode('UTF-16LE')
        user_bytes = (@config[:username] || '').encode('UTF-16LE')
        ws_bytes = (Socket.gethostname || '').encode('UTF-16LE')
        
        fields << [domain_bytes.length, domain_bytes.length, offset].pack('vvV')
        offset += domain_bytes.length
        fields << [user_bytes.length, user_bytes.length, offset].pack('vvV')
        offset += user_bytes.length
        fields << [ws_bytes.length, ws_bytes.length, offset].pack('vvV')
        
        fields << lm_response << nt_response << domain_bytes << user_bytes << ws_bytes
        fields
      end
    end

    class AuditLogger
      def initialize(log_path)
        @log_path = log_path
        @logger = Logger.new(log_path, 'daily')
        @logger.level = Logger::INFO
      end

      def log_event(event_type, details = {})
        sanitized = details.transform_values { |v| sanitize_for_log(v) }
        @logger.info("[NTLM_AUTH] #{event_type}: #{sanitized.inspect}")
      end

      private

      def sanitize_for_log(value)
        return value unless value.is_a?(String)
        value.gsub(/[\r\n]/, ' ').slice(0, 256)
      end
    end

    class AuthError < StandardError; end
  end
end
